Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the supplied main-menu concept image into ONE new portrait mobile game main menu for the newly named game CAR STARS. Tall 1:2 aspect, edge-to-edge, no phone device frame, one screenshot only. Reference is previous menu artwork; preserve its sunny chunky low-poly miniature city, clean matte cars, yellow getaway sedan with navy windows, white/navy police vehicles with red-blue rooftop lightbars, simple cream/peach/skyblue buildings with blue roofs and no windows, warm sunlight, slate blue road, restrained navy/cream rounded UI. Completely replace the old CAR WARS branding and stacked choice-card layout.
NEW SCREEN SYSTEM: screen split into two adjoining VERTICAL visual panels, thief on LEFT, city law-enforcement on RIGHT, with a clean slightly slanted dividing seam. The selected side expands to occupy about 70% of the selectable screen width and the unselected side contracts to about 30%. Panels fill the available hero area from beneath header to above bottom button; this must be an immersive split scene, NOT two cards beneath an unrelated scene. One compact shared two-line 3D logo "CAR" / "STARS" centered near the top, same white upper/gold lower lettering with navy outline as reference, much smaller than old logo to leave room for selection scene. Beneath logo a short cream label "ВЫБЕРИ СТОРОНУ". At bottom one very large full-width rounded PLAY button, exact Latin "PLAY", centered triangular play symbol immediately left, spanning both panels; no separate play button per faction. Small unobtrusive settings gear in safe area. Minimal interface, large artwork and large selected-role name.
Role meaning is essential: thief controls one yellow car; law-enforcer controls the CITY as a whole, directing multiple police units and roads, not a single police car driver. CITY panel depicts a recognizable overhead miniature city district: several interconnected blocks and intersections, THREE distinguishable police cars at different streets, the yellow suspect in another street, blue map pins and one simple blue route/coordination line as intuitive visual motif. No humans, no weapons, no helicopter, no shops, no coin currency, no HUD speedometer, no joystick, no rewards here. No English except "CAR", "STARS", "PLAY". All other quoted text exactly Cyrillic. Retain broad shapes readable on a 390px-wide phone. No watermarks.STATE A: THIEF SELECTED. LEFT golden warm panel occupies 70% of screen width, RIGHT blue city panel occupies 30%. LEFT contains a large hero yellow sedan drifting through a street corner with a clean tire arc, elevated three-quarter view, several simple city building masses in background. RIGHT contains the entire miniature law-enforcement district at a smaller overview scale, clearly showing several police units, rather than one large hero cop car. Upper panel labels "УГОНЩИК" left and "ГОРОД" right fit within their respective panel widths. In lower portion of expanded LEFT panel show a checkmark capsule "ВЫБРАНО", large role name "УГОНЩИК" and short subtitle "Уйди от погони". Collapsed RIGHT contains only its short label "ГОРОД" and artwork, no long role text. The single bottom PLAY button is bright gold with navy text. Keep header, main scene, and bottom controls uncropped and spacious.
